_notes: StreamDiffusionV2 14B (Wan2.1-T2V-14B causal DMD v2v). Weights: SDV2_14B=1 bash deploy/setup_sdv2_env.sh (28.6 GB checkpoint + 14B config.json; UMT5/tokenizer/VAE are shared with the 1.3B). Needs ~45-55 GB VRAM: RTX PRO 6000 / H100 class.
1 step is upstream's 14B default (run_v2v.sh, demo/start.sh): a 14B DiT call costs ~10x a 1.3B one, so each extra step roughly halves fps. Try steps 2 only if fps allows.
512x512 = upstream's live-demo size. If it measures below ~12 fps, drop to 448x448 (784 tokens/frame, ~25% less DiT work) before anything else; below 448 the 14B's quality edge fades.
UMT5 on the GPU (auto picks it on a 96 GB card): prompt changes encode in ~0.1 s instead of seconds on CPU.
